title: TEST: wp11_backend_soft_ops has zero test coverage
description: src/wp11_backend_soft.c: soft_sign, soft_verify, and soft_decrypt are never called by any test. The PKCS#11 tests cannot exercise the soft backend because C_CreateObject and C_GenerateKeyPair both return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED; there is no path to add keys to the soft token through the PKCS#11 API. wp11_backend_soft_ops is exported but dead from a test perspective. The flash backend sign roundtrip test (test_flash_pkcs11_sign_roundtrip) correctly uses an independent oracle; the soft backend needs an equivalent. Fix: add wp11_test_backend_soft.c that calls soft_sign/soft_verify/soft_decrypt directly (bypassing the PKCS#11 layer), with independent oracles: for ECDSA, generate a key with wolfCrypt, sign with the soft backend, verify with a direct wc_ecc_verify_hash call on the original key; for RSA, sign with the soft backend, verify with wc_RsaSSL_Verify. Do NOT sign-then-verify through the same path. Per BUILD.md test integrity rules, these must be cross-validated, not self-referential.
